_what_this_is: The hand-CUDA track's certification record: which kernels in step_curl_kernels.py have been measured byte-identical to the array path, on what, and with what still open. It is the sibling of triton_kernels/fingerprints.json and exists for the same reason — a device-side verdict that lives only in an untracked results/ directory is a verdict nothing at the merge bar can check. test_certification_record.py welds it to the shipped source without a GPU.
_what_it_deliberately_does_not_claim: This record names ONLY the kernels it certifies. The other twelve in step_curl_kernels.py are not listed here as covered, partially covered, or pending: they are listed in that file's UNCERTIFIED_KERNELS as dead, and the partition test requires the two sets to be disjoint and to exhaust the fourteen. Inflating this list to cover the directory is the failure mode the partition test exists to prevent.
_metadata_convention: Every block in this record that names a DEVICE must also say when it ran, where it ran, which bytes of evidence it left behind, and under which float32 subnormal policy. test_certification_metadata.py enumerates those blocks mechanically (a top-level object carrying device or environment.device_name) and requires all four facts, so a block added later cannot escape the requirement by not being listed anywhere. The four facts, and the spelling each block uses: WHEN is recorded_utc, or started_utc in bit_identity_gate, whose environment block is a verbatim transcription of the probe's own payload and sidecar and is left in the artifact's spelling so it stays checkable against them; the value must be one of the started_utc stamps the block's artifact tree actually carries, and where a block is several device legs it is the EARLIEST such stamp, i.e. when the block's first leg began. WHERE is host, or environment.hostname in bit_identity_gate. WHICH BYTES is artifact_sha256, defined below. WHICH POLICY is subnormal_policy, or policies_cut_under where a block was cut under both — which, since the 2026-08-22 re-cut, every device block in this record is.
_artifact_sha256_rule: A manifest digest over the block's artifact directory, so one hex string pins a tree the repository does not track. Rule, recomputable by anyone holding the directory: take every *.json under it recursively, sort by POSIX path relative to that directory, write one line per file as '<relative path> <sha256 of the file>', join the lines with a single newline (no trailing newline) and sha256 the result. JSON ONLY, deliberately: the verdict payloads are what this record's numbers are read from, whereas the .log, .md, .sh and .py files beside them are context and drivers, and pinning those would make an edit to a summary script read as evidence drifting. test_certification_metadata.py recomputes this wherever the directory is present and names the differing files when it does not match.
_certified_kernels_note: The real-field split-field PML curl pair. They are also the only two kernels in the file whose stencil is parenthesized to stepping.py's expression tree, which is the condition the --fmad=false bit-identity claim rests on (step_curl_kernels.py, the _COMPILE_OPTIONS docstring).
_certified_module_sha256_source: parity/meep_gpu/results/fused_pml_bit_identity_hand_2026-08-22_rename/{keep,flush}/probe.json:kernel_source_sha256, identical to each leg's PROVENANCE.txt:module_sha256 — the bytes the re-cut gate actually compiled and launched, and the same digest on both policy legs.
_revision_sha256_note: The shipped step_curl_kernels.py as of this record. It is EQUAL to certified_module_sha256 again, because the 2026-08-22 re-cut ran the gate on the shipped bytes rather than annotating a drift, which is why post_certification_edits is empty. The test asserts the live file matches THIS digest, so the file cannot change without the record being updated in the same change — and while the two digests are equal, any such change also has to be declared as a post-certification edit or re-gated.

bit_identity_gate._what_this_is: THE PRIMARY VERDICT for the certified curl pair, RE-CUT on 2026-08-22 on the device strings the shipped module carries today. It replaces the 2026-08-09/10 cut entirely: adding the folded-PERIODIC top-plane branch (BC_MIRROR_PERIODIC) moved both certified kernel sources, so the older verdict described bytes that no longer ship. THE RE-CUT IS STRICTLY STRONGER THAN WHAT IT REPLACES: same 120/120 single launch under the primary guard, plus a 120/120 SUBNORMAL-BAND leg the 2026-08-09 run did not have at all, 60 identical consecutive launches per multi-step run instead of 8, and every one of those numbers taken twice, once under each float32 subnormal policy. Nothing here was carried forward from the old run except the sweep it defines.
bit_identity_gate._artifact_sha256_is: 2 verdict payloads — flush/probe.json, keep/probe.json — by the rule at the head of this record, recomputed 2026-08-20 against the directory as it stands in this checkout. The 2026-08-09 predecessor digested 13 payloads because the mutation legs and the lifted-case leg wrote into the same directory; this re-cut ran the gate and multi-step experiments only, which is one payload per policy leg.
bit_identity_gate._started_utc_is_the_earliest_leg: keep began at 2026-08-22T07:04:55Z and flush at 2026-08-22T07:06:50Z; both stamps are in the artifact and this is the earlier of the two, i.e. when the block's first device leg began — the same convention the three blocks stamped on 2026-08-19 follow.
bit_identity_gate._policies_cut_under_is_new_here: The 2026-08-09 cut predated the policy machinery and recorded none, which was carried as declared debt in test_certification_metadata.py's METADATA_DEBT. This re-cut ran a full leg under each policy, in a private CUPY_CACHE_DIR named for the resolved policy, so the debt is DISCHARGED by measurement and the entry was deleted rather than re-worded.
bit_identity_gate._single_launch_columns_are_the_normal_nu: single_launch_guarded and single_launch_unguarded are the UNIFORM class, and both hold identically on each policy leg. per_policy below carries all four columns separately, including the single place the two legs differ: under keep the UNGUARDED band leg agrees on 1 case of 120 and under flush on 0. A coincidence in one unguarded case is not a claim about the guard — the guarded column is 120/120 in both classes on both policies.
bit_identity_gate._unguarded_is_the_null_control: The unguarded column is what stops the guarded one from being a comparison of two identical things: under the default NVRTC options (no --fmad=false) the same 120 normal-number cases are 0/120 identical on both policies, so the guard is doing the work the record credits it with.
bit_identity_gate._structurally_invalid_skipped_is_per_cla: 8 of the 128 (sub-step x shape x boundary set x dtdx) combinations are refused by Grid — axis 2 has one cell and a metallic wall — leaving the 120 that run. The artifact reports 16 per guard because it counts both value classes.

open_gaps.what: Under the flush policy the HOST FPU flushes the graded band seeds as NumPy converts them float64 -> float32, so only the directly-assigned needle constants reach the device as subnormals: 562,232 measured against 564,902 predicted from N/16 x 3/7, with the lost values reappearing as SIGNED zeros (189,224 -> 4,878,544). Under keep the same generator delivers 9,910,176.
open_gaps.why_it_matters: The flush band leg is still non-vacuous and its 120/120 stands, but its coverage is the needle constants, not the graded band. The two policies' band legs are therefore not the same operand set, and a reader comparing them case for case would be comparing different draws.
open_gaps.what_would_close_it: Generate the band seeds on device, or before the host policy is installed, so the operand set is the policy's independent variable rather than its consequence.

recut_2026-08-15._what_this_is: The re-cut the six 2026-08-14 gaps were waiting on: a SECOND cut taken under both float32 subnormal policies with the operand and parameter classes the 2026-08-09 one lacked. Without it the 240/240 is a number with no scale: the control shows the comparator diverging on essentially every case when the arithmetic guard is removed, which is what makes the guarded pass evidence rather than an assertion.

distinct_binaries_per_policy._what_this_settles: That 'identical under both policies' is two measurements and not one binary served twice. A source hash cannot answer it — both policies compile the same source — so the bytes NVRTC returned were observed at the seam the policy acts on.
distinct_binaries_per_policy._warm_cache_control: 0 compiles on a warm directory: CuPy's disk cache answers ABOVE the strip seam, so a directory shared between the policies would serve one policy's binaries under the other's name. That is the measured reason each leg takes a private policy-token-carrying CUPY_CACHE_DIR.

recut_2026-08-15._cut_on_a_third_module_revision: MEASURED off this artifact's own sidecars: keep/PROVENANCE.txt and flush/PROVENANCE.txt both stamp module_sha256 bea05bc8, which is neither the 2026-08-09 blob (dc4c0856) nor the shipped one (ba106d81). constitutive_2026-08-15._what_this_is: First certification of the REAL-STORAGE CONSTITUTIVE pair, cut to the standard the curl pair was re-cut to on the same day: both float32 subnormal policies, proven-distinct binaries, a 60-launch multi-step budget, subnormal-band and signed-zero operands with a census, an inexact Courant, armed-mutation launch accounting, and two must-be-UNCAUGHT controls. Before it the hand-CUDA track had ZERO rows covered at every sub-step, because no real-storage constitutive kernel existed.
constitutive_2026-08-15._recorded_utc_is_later_than_the_block_na: The block is named for the LOCAL date on the GPU host; its first device leg began at 00:50 UTC the following day. Both are correct and the UTC one is the checkable one, which is why it is the field the test reads.
constitutive_2026-08-15._host_was_null_until_2026-08-19: The summarizer reads environment.hostname off the gate payload (summarize_constitutive_recut.py:215) and NO CUDA gate payload carries that key — measured on keep/cgate.json and on the 2026-08-09 gate.json, whose environment blocks are identical in shape and both hostname-free. The host is stamped only in the probe's PROVENANCE.txt sidecar, which says the GPU host on both policy legs. So the null was not a run whose host went unrecorded; it was a summarizer reading the one payload that never had it.
constitutive_2026-08-15._why_an_inexact_courant: 0.5 is exact in float32, so a contracted and an uncontracted expression round identically and the leg cannot distinguish --fmad=false from the default options. 0.35 is not representable and is where the guard becomes measurable.

guard_control_at_corpus_scale._what_this_settles: It was MEANT to settle that --fmad=false is load-bearing at corpus scale as well as on synthetic arrays. It settles the opposite, and that is the useful result: the corpus cases CANNOT exercise the contraction guard for this sub-step at all. The leg agreed on all twelve cases at BOTH Courants.
guard_control_at_corpus_scale._why_not: The only non-unit factors in this sub-step are kps/kms off the absorber profile, and pml.py:686 builds the interior as the exact identity kps == kms == 1.0. fma(1.0f, src, f) and f + 1.0f*src are the same float32, so a contraction is invisible outside the layer -- and MEASURED by probe_constitutive_absorber_reach.py, in the 2 warm-up + 8 compared steps the pulse has not reached the layer: 0 of 6 cases have a single cell where a coefficient bites AND the operand is nonzero. This does NOT transfer from the curl, where dtdx multiplies the stencil in every cell.
guard_control_at_corpus_scale._what_the_corpus_leg_IS_evidence_for: The transcription at corpus scale against the driver's own tables: the coefficient indexing, the H/E sub-lattice pairing, the two-accumulation grouping, and the f_w recurrence over 8 whole steps on volumes up to 2560x2560x1 and 180x180x180.
guard_control_at_corpus_scale._where_the_guard_evidence_actually_IS: per_policy.<policy>.per_guard.default_no_options in this same block: the synthetic gate's unguarded control diverges on every case it runs, under both policies.
guard_control_at_corpus_scale._leg_ran_validly_derived: covered > 0, live == covered, and an inexact Courant present. The artifact's own 'pass' field is False because it was written under the superseded criterion that REQUIRED divergence.
guard_control_at_corpus_scale.diverged_field_derived: covered_at_inexact_dtdx - identical_at_inexact_dtdx; the leg predates the field

distinct_binaries_per_policy._what_this_settles: That 'identical under both policies' is two measurements and not one binary served twice. Attributed PER KERNEL by bracketing the observation index around each compile, because CuPy compiles kernels of its own in the same process and some of those ARE byte-identical across the policies.

policy_reaches_these_kernels._what_this_settles: Not merely that the bytes differ, but that the policy changes what THIS kernel computes. A float32 subnormal is planted in the source, delivered as uint32 and reinterpreted on the device so nothing can flush it in flight, and the target is read back.
policy_reaches_these_kernels._the_two_auxiliary_controls: fw[idx] = src is a plain store on the H side (src is B) and a MULTIPLY on the E side (src is D*inv_eps). The H auxiliary must therefore keep the needle under BOTH policies and the E one must not under flush -- which is an independent confirmation that the inverse-epsilon multiply sits where stepping.py:982 puts it.

offdiag_2026-08-16._what_this_is: First certification of the OFF-DIAGONAL (tensor epsilon) electric constitutive sub-step, update_E_pml_real_offdiag, cut to the standard the curl pair and the plain constitutive pair were cut to: both float32 subnormal policies, binaries PROVEN distinct per compiled row-mask variant, a 60-launch multi-step budget, subnormal-band and uniform operand classes with a census, an inexact Courant, armed-mutation launch accounting, two must-be-UNCAUGHT controls and a must-be-NULL-on-periodic pair for every wall-mask defect. offdiag_2026-08-16._certified_kernels_note: ONE NAME, MANY SOURCES. This family's device code is emitted per row mask, so the name is shared by 63 possible bodies. The gate sweeps four of them — the two the 186-row corpus drives, a single-slot mask and a mask that leaves two components on the PLAIN arm — and the policy probe compiles three. What is certified is the EMITTER at the recorded corpus digest, exercised on those masks; a mask outside them is covered by the emitter's own tests and by that digest, not by a byte gate.

offdiag_2026-08-16._why_an_inexact_courant: 0.5 is exact in float32, so a contracted and an uncontracted expression round identically and the leg cannot distinguish --fmad=false from the default options. 0.35 is not representable and is where the guard becomes measurable.

needle._what_it_shows: That the policy reaches THIS FAMILY'S OWN ARITHMETIC rather than merely changing its bytes. Every D volume is one float32 subnormal n = 2**-135, every coefficient exactly 1, kps = 1, kms = 0, all periodic: the coupled component must land on EXACTLY 2n and the uncoupled ones on EXACTLY n under keep, and all of them on exact zero under -ftz=true. The coupled/uncoupled split is the discriminator -- a leg where they agree is a leg whose coupling never fired.

in_seam_2026-08-21._what_this_is: The three IN-SEAM PASSES the driver runs between a curl and the constitutive that closes it, ported to CUDA device code and each gated SEPARATELY against the stepping function it transcribes. Before this block the hand-CUDA track had zero device code for any of them -- measured 2026-08-21 by module count, zero_metal 19 Triton modules / 21 Metal / 0 CUDA, fill_symmetry 12 / 17 / 0, fill_folded_far_ghosts 11 / 17 / 0 -- so a CUDA sub-step returned to the host between the curl and the constitutive by construction.
_what_it_does_not_claim: NO FUSION. Nothing here fuses anything. Each pass is its own launch measured against its own array-path function, and this block licenses no fused product and shortens no seam by itself. What it supplies is the PARTS such a product would have to absorb.
NO THROUGHPUT. No timing was taken and none is derivable from this run.
NO DISPATCH. No module in meep_gpu/ imports cuda_kernels at all (test_package_boundary.py pins the absence in both directions), so this is a statement about six kernels and not about any run.
NO COMPLEX STORAGE. A Bloch run stores complex64 and these kernels index float32; in_seam_coverage refuses it by name and no complex case was swept. This is the largest single gap in the slice.

NO CYLINDRICAL RADIAL AXIS. stepping._mirror_phases puts (-1)**m in the mirror-phase slot for r, whose per-component sign rule is r_to_minus_r_symmetry's rather than mirror_parity's. Refused by name, never swept.

THE THREE PASSES WERE NEVER RUN AS ONE. They share planes -- on a mirrored X beside a metallic Y, Dz's near fill and its wall wipe meet on the edge Dz[0, 0, :] -- so a composed run could not say which pass owned a divergence. Each verdict here stands alone and none of them is a verdict about the composition.
in_seam_2026-08-21._a_separate_predicate_module_deliberatel: coverage.py's bytes are pinned by digest in thirty-seven places in this record, so a new predicate landing there would move a digest no device run of this tranche backs. in_seam_coverage.py is a new file and changes not one byte of that one.
in_seam_2026-08-21._the_contraction_guard_is_carried_not_ea: --fmad=false is carried for consistency with the rest of this track. NO device string in this module contains a contractible a*b + c -- every expression is a single multiply or a store, which test_in_seam_passes.py checks textually -- and the unguarded control leg was bit-identical on every case of every pass under both policies. So this run carries NO evidence that the guard changed an answer here, and the guard_control field of each artifact says so in those words.

policy_binaries._measured: The two policy legs compiled DISTINCT binaries for the four FILL kernels and IDENTICAL binaries for the two WIPE kernels, and the split is a property of the kernels rather than of the harness: zero_metal stores the constant +0.0f and performs no floating-point arithmetic at all, so -ftz=true has nothing in it to change. The keep leg's nvrtc report records any_ftz_true_reached_nvrtc false and the flush leg's records all_ftz_true_reached_nvrtc true, on all three passes.
policy_binaries._what_that_costs: The zero_metal policy pair is a CONTROL ON THE HARNESS, not a discriminator on the kernel: it shows the two legs ran and agreed, and it cannot show that the wipe is proof against a policy it is incapable of noticing. _the_floors_that_refuse_a_vacuous_verdic: oracle_moved -- the fraction of the family's words the ARRAY PATH changed from the frozen input. Every one of these passes is a plane write, so a state that already satisfies the boundary condition is a fixed point; a case that moved nothing is SKIPPED with the reason recorded, never scored.

the launch count -- a pass with no live axis on a grid issues no launch, and a leg that launched nothing and compared equal is the purest vacuous pass there is. Both floors are RELAXED for a mutated leg deliberately: 'the array path does nothing here and the kernel writes a plane' is the strongest form of a catch and is exactly what wall_folded_metallic_axis plants.

operand_census -- how many subnormals and signed zeros the operands really hold, per case, so non-vacuity of the band class is a property of the record rather than of a reader's trust in the generator.

every axis live somewhere -- the three have the slowest, middle and fastest stride, and a face decomposition that confuses them is bit-identical on a sweep that only ever exercises one. live_axes is [0, 1, 2] on all six legs.
both full-count parities on a live folded axis, for the far fill -- the image row is stored-2 at an even count and stored-3 at an odd one.

_the_mutations_that_must_be_uncaught.reverse_axis_order: host, both fills. Every fill is a multiply by exactly +/-1 from a plane no other axis's fill writes, so two axes' fills commute bitwise. 0/6 caught on both fills under both policies. Paired with drop_last_launch on the SAME plan, which is 12/12 and 14/14 CAUGHT -- otherwise 'inert' would be indistinguishable from 'never asked'.
_the_mutations_that_must_be_uncaught.commute_parity_scale: source, both fills. phase * f[...] becomes f[...] * phase; float32 multiply is bitwise commutative. 0/6 and 0/7 caught.
_the_mutations_that_must_be_uncaught.reload_through_register: source, both fills. The value round-trips through a named register before the store; a float32 in a 32-bit register is the identity on the bits. 0/6 and 0/7 caught.
_the_mutations_that_must_be_uncaught.transpose_face_strides: source, zero_metal ONLY. face_geometry's y branch takes the z branch's ROW STRIDE. The wipe stores a constant at base and never steps a row, so the stride is dead code in it -- 0/3 caught, and CAUGHT 4/4 on both fills, where the stride decides which plane the ghost images. Paired with transpose_face_base, which edits the SAME helper and is 3/3 CAUGHT on the wipe.

_the_policy_dependent_mutation.copy_instead_of_multiply: REPORTED, NOT SCORED, and the reading is the point. The array path writes phase * field[...], a float32 multiply. Under keep, a copy is the identity wherever the plane phase is +1 and caught wherever it is -1; under flush, CuPy compiles with -ftz=true and the multiply FLUSHES a subnormal operand while a copy preserves it, so the leg bites more often. MEASURED: fill_symmetry 4/12 caught under keep against 8/12 under flush, fill_folded_far 12/14 against 13/14. That is why the phase == +1 case is not special-cased into an assignment, and it is a measurement rather than a release clause.

_the_two_sharpest_mutations.wall_folded_metallic_axis: host, zero_metal. stepping._zero_metal's 'not is_mirrored' term armed as a defect: a folded METALLIC axis is added to the walled set. Its stored cell 0 is the fold's parity-weighted ghost, not a wall, and clearing it destroys the fold -- 1.28e+00 complex relative L2 against CPU MEEP in the engine's own docstring, against 2.0e-07 with the skip in place. 4/4 CAUGHT under both policies.
_the_two_sharpest_mutations.reflect_row_n_minus_two: host, fill_folded_far. The fixed stored-2 image row, baked. MEASURED on a laptop over eight full counts 12..19 before the gate ran: the real row is stored-2 at an EVEN full count and stored-3 at an ODD one, so this mutation is INERT at even counts BY CONSTRUCTION and is scored only on odd-count specs. 6/6 CAUGHT. A battery that mixed the parities would have reported PARTIAL for a reason about the case table.

cuda_fused_hd_pair_2026-09-06._what_this_is: THE H->D WELD: one launch spanning the driver's update_H consult (driver.py:3311) and its step_D consult (:3315) -- the FOURTH fusion seam and the first whose two halves sit in the order constitutive-then-curl. The shape is the SCRATCH-OUTPUT FOREIGN-CELL RECOMPUTE that offdiag_stencil_weld.py already ships on the mirror-image D->E seam: the constitutive half writes H and f_w_H to LAUNCH-LOCAL SCRATCH, so H, f_w_H and B are const for the whole dispatch and no thread can observe another thread's store; each of the curl's six shifted magnetic taps is a RECOMPUTE of update_H at the resolved cell rather than a load of a word another block is writing; D and fu_D step IN PLACE, which is safe by construction because pml_apply touches f[idx] and fu[idx] and nothing else; and the launcher ROTATES the H/f_w_H bindings against the scratch afterwards. ONE DEVICE STRING covers every boundary configuration, because on this backend a mirrored periodic axis is a RUNTIME code (BC_MIRROR_PERIODIC) inside the certified curl rather than a separate folded arm -- which is why the CUDA cell is 127 corpus rows where the sibling Metal backend splits the same corpus into 49 unfolded and 78 folded. THE LIFT IS STRING WORK OVER CERTIFIED TEXT, with every edit declared as data and no arithmetic in either table: the certified shift_dn is lifted as a WHOLE HELPER so the branch, the periodic wrap's integer expression and the exact 0.0f a metallic or mirror ghost reads are the certified helper's own, and the two leaf loads' index expressions are PARSED out of the certified lines rather than retyped; the certified index decode stays inside the recompute, because it is what indexes the absorber profile at the recomputed cell rather than at the thread's own. Byte-identical per COMPLETE DRIVER STEP, as uint32 words over every stored volume, against FOUR references stepped from one seed -- the array path, the certified singles, the composition the composer installs on these rows today (the released B->H pair plus the released D->E pair), and the same slots dispatched unfused -- on nine boundary and fold fixtures in two value classes, at six block sizes, and over the corpus cell's own rows.
cuda_fused_hd_pair_2026-09-06._shipped_kernel_count_note: ONE device string for the whole family, because the boundary kind is a runtime argument on this backend (BC_PERIODIC / BC_METALLIC / BC_MIRROR_PERIODIC, step_curl_kernels.py's _REAL_PML_PRELUDE) rather than a compile-time specialisation. So one certification digest covers every fold orientation and no per-boundary variant can end up pinned that nobody ran.

accumulations_regrouped.why: the two SEPARATE accumulations become one expression `f + (kps*src - kms*prev)`, which is a different float32 number because addition is not associative (constitutive_kernels.py note 1)

coefficient_index_is_the_threads_own.why: the recomputed cell's absorber coefficients are taken from the origin instead of from the recomputed cell -- the half-cell class of error, converged and smooth

drop_the_near_face_curl_masks.why: the near-face ownership masks -- the BC_METALLIC and BC_MIRROR_PERIODIC `== 0` clears -- are removed, so the curl at a wall plane is assembled from a ghost the cell does not own. This is the pass that makes ghost_replaced_by_the_wrapped_cell null, and a null whose cause is not itself measured is an assumption

f_w_H_written_in_place.why: the split-field history is stored IN PLACE, so a foreign recompute reading fw at a cell another block already wrote gets B where its recurrence needs B_prev. RACY BY CONSTRUCTION: whether it fires is a schedule, which is why the deterministic twin below is armed beside it

foreign_history_reads_the_post_store_val.why: THE DETERMINISTIC TWIN of the in-place store: the recurrence reads the value the in-place arrangement would have handed it, with no race to depend on. This is the arithmetic consequence the racy mutation can only sometimes produce

foreign_tap_reads_B.why: the tap reads the constitutive SOURCE rather than its result. Under mu = 1 outside the absorber H and B are close, so this is the plausible wrong answer rather than an obvious one

foreign_tap_reads_stale_H.why: the foreign tap loads the PRE-LAUNCH magnetic field instead of recomputing update_H there -- which is what an unfused step_D would read and is exactly one sub-step behind

ghost_replaced_by_the_wrapped_cell.why: the metallic and mirror-periodic ghost -- an exact 0.0f -- is replaced by the constitutive recomputed at the WRAPPED cell. This is the boundary rule the whole lift exists to preserve
ghost_replaced_by_the_wrapped_cell.predicted_null: the certified step_D zeroes the curl of the component this tap feeds at exactly the plane the near-face ghost is served on (stepping._mask_non_owned_cells, transcribed in step_curl_kernels.py's notes 2 and 3 and measured by gate_cuda_folded_curl.py / results/cuda_folded_curl_2026-08-19/), so no near-face ghost VALUE is observable in this kernel's output and this edit cannot diverge. The ghost_attribution sub-leg drops those masks and requires the same edit to change the answer, which is what makes the null a measurement

own_cell_reads_stale_H.why: the thread's OWN cell load reverts to the pre-launch volume, so Dx's curl differences an H one sub-step behind on one of its two terms

Re-running is what licenses re-binding them; nothing else does.

An earlier attempt to close the same drift installed the fresh legs INTO the dated directories: the weld ledger went to zero drift and four certification tests went red, because a block's artifact digest is computed over its own directory. A record that disagrees with its own directory is worse than an honest drift, so that attempt was reverted; results/_pre_regate_2026-08-30/ holds the originals verbatim and this tree holds the re-gate.

IT IS NOT A COVERAGE CLAIM. The kernels, cases, shapes and mutation legs are exactly the ones each family block already describes. Read the numbers there; the only new fact here is the date and the bytes.
